articles.body:
To my understanding, there can be two scenarios when a Crisis would trigger an attack against the company:

1) The elephant is located in the center of the company controlled region;
2) The elephant is placed on the boundary and pointing to a company controlled region.

Is this correct?
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>To my understanding, there can be two scenarios when a Crisis would trigger an attack against the company:<br/><br/>1) The elephant is located in the center of the company controlled region;<br/>2) The elephant is placed on the boundary and pointing to a company controlled region.<br/><br/>Is this correct?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
1) Correct, this would represent a local rebellion against Company rule in that region.
2) Correct, this would be one of other Indian petty kingdoms invading the Company.

There is also the "Foreign Invasion" event, which would represent a seaborne invasion by one of Britain's enemies: France, or the Dutch, likely invited by and thus in league with the local Indian rebels.

articles.body:
[q="Spiritseeker"]To my understanding, there can be two scenarios when a Crisis would trigger an attack against the company:

1) The elephant is located in the center of the company controlled region;
2) The elephant is placed on the boundary and pointing to a company controlled region.

Is this correct?[/q]
Also note that any attack against the Company also triggers a rebellion in any other regions that have unrest cubes. This means that Crises, Leaders and Foreign Invasions can all trigger additional attacks against the Company.
